title: [ORION-QG QG-28] Exact local-Clifford orbit compression of TARE column-count geometry from 4096 to 715 types
body:
Parent programme: #740.
Direct parents: QG-26 #884 / PR #885 exact 4096-column histogram geometry; QG-27 #886 / PR #887 bulk four-form asymptotic geometry.
Method donors: finite group actions, Burnside/Pólya counting, invariant theory, local Clifford/symplectic automorphisms.

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE EXACT SYMMETRY-QUOTIENT THEOREM — freeze before execution.**

QG-26 proves that, for a fixed matching, exact all-n TARE cost depends only on the 4096-dimensional histogram of six-target local Pauli-column types

`t in {I,X,Y,Z}^6`.

The phase-free one-qubit Pauli algebra is `F_2^2`. Its full automorphism group is

`GL(2,2) ~= S_3`,

which fixes I and permutes X,Y,Z. The frozen TARE grammar uses only quantities invariant/equivariant under this automorphism: local multiplication, symplectic anticommutation, nonidentity weight, equality/nonidentity in F3, and sums/XORs of these local quantities.

Crucially, a different automorphism may be applied at **each physical qubit coordinate independently**, provided it is applied simultaneously to all six target letters and every local frame/Tag letter at that coordinate. This is a local-Clifford conjugation symmetry of the abstract cost/feasibility problem.

## Q1 — complete local equivariance

Enumerate all 6 automorphisms phi of `{I,X,Y,Z}` fixing I and permuting X,Y,Z. Require for every phi and every local letters:
- `phi(local_mul(a,b)) = local_mul(phi(a),phi(b))` for all 16 pairs;
- `local_symp(phi(a),phi(b)) = local_symp(a,b)` for all 16 pairs;
- `local_wt(phi(a)) = local_wt(a)` for all 4 letters;
- `F3(phi(a),phi(b),phi(c)) = F3(a,b,c)` for all 64 triples.

Production binds these independently reconstructed identities to frozen R6M tables. Generic ORION rebuilds `F_2^2` independently.

## Q2 — exact orbit census on target-column alphabet

Let S3 act diagonally on the six entries of one target-column type.

Burnside fixed sets are frozen falsifiable targets:
- identity: `4^6 = 4096` fixed types;
- each of the 3 transpositions of X/Y/Z fixes exactly I plus one nonidentity letter, hence `2^6 = 64` types;
- each of the 2 three-cycles fixes only I, hence `1^6 = 1` type.

Therefore expected orbit count:

`(4096 + 3*64 + 2*1)/6 = 715`.

Enumerate the complete 4096 types and require exact orbit-size distribution:
- 1 orbit of size 1;
- 63 orbits of size 3;
- 651 orbits of size 6.

Every type receives a deterministic canonical representative, lexicographically minimum in its orbit.

## Q3 — independent-coordinate symmetry and 715-count sufficient statistic

Because the S3 automorphism can be chosen independently per physical coordinate, every n-qubit target instance can be transformed cost-preservingly so that each qubit column is its canonical orbit representative.

Thus if `M_o` is the total number of columns belonging to orbit o, the 715-vector

`M=(M_o)`

is an exact sufficient statistic: any two valid target instances with the same 715 orbit-count vector have the same frozen exact optimum.

This is stronger than merely saying the 4096 histogram is invariant under one global S3 action.

## Mandatory unsafe-symmetry barrier

Block permutations and swaps of the two target strings inside each block are only **global** relabelings of whole target strings. They cannot be chosen independently at each physical coordinate.

QG-28 V1 must explicitly reject the tempting but invalid step of aggregating the 4096 column types under an independently applied block/branch-position group. A local combined S3×(S2^3⋊S3) orbit count (which would be much smaller) is not a sufficient statistic unless a separate cross-column theorem is proved.

Native ORION-Q must keep `INDEPENDENT_POSITION_RELABEL_PER_COLUMN=false`.

## Q4 — QG-26 guarded tropical geometry descends to 715 orbit counts

For each QG-26 active template, independently transform each active coordinate's target type to its canonical S3 orbit representative and apply the same local automorphism to that coordinate's six frame letters and Tag letter. Equivariance preserves:
- acceptance;
- local structural support cost;
- Restore/F3 correction;
- multiplicity.

Spectator baseline coefficients are constant on each S3 orbit. Therefore every QG-26 baseline vector descends from 4096 coefficients to 715 orbit coefficients, and every active-template guard becomes an orbit-count multiplicity guard.

Hence exact all-n cost admits a finite guarded min-affine representation directly on `N^715`.

## Q5 — exact baseline quotient controls

Reconstruct all 8 QG-26 spectator baseline vectors and require:
- each is constant on every one of the 715 S3 orbits;
- the eight vectors still collapse to 4 distinct quotient vectors;
- each 715-vector has exact representative-value histogram
  `{0:1,1:8,2:44,3:128,4:222,5:216,6:96}`;
- lifting each quotient vector back to 4096 entries using orbit membership reproduces the parent QG-26 vector exactly.

The histogram above counts orbits, not weighted alphabet multiplicity; do not confuse it with QG-26's 4096-entry coefficient histogram.

## Q6 — exact active-template local controls

On all 715 canonical target representatives, all 48 one-coordinate feasible shared-label auxiliary rows, all 8 target-permutation tuples and canonical central tuple `(0,0,0)`, verify that:
- direct local cost before canonicalization equals local cost after applying every admissible automorphism mapping the target to its canonical rep and transforming auxiliary letters with it;
- the baseline-plus-K decomposition is unchanged.

Generic ORION independently reproduces aggregate digests.

## Q7 — compression consequence

QG-28 may authorize:
- `LOCAL_CLIFFORD_ORBIT_COUNT = 715`;
- `ORBIT_HISTOGRAM_SUFFICIENT_STATISTIC_ALL_N`;
- `GUARDED_TROPICAL_GEOMETRY_DESCENDS_TO_715_COUNTS`;
- exact local-Clifford invariance under independently chosen per-qubit automorphisms.

It may **not** authorize:
- a smaller independent per-column quotient using global target-position relabelings;
- explicit complete template-basis enumeration;
- practical static forecaster;
- chain/B'' completeness;
- physical equivalence beyond the abstract frozen compiler objective.

## Intended terminal

`QG28_TARE_EXACT_COST_DESCENDS_TO_715_LOCAL_CLIFFORD_COLUMN_ORBIT_COUNTS_ALL_N`

Honest alternatives:
- `QG28_LOCAL_AUTOMORPHISM_EQUIVARIANCE_REFUTED`
- `QG28_BASELINE_NOT_CONSTANT_ON_ORBIT`
- `QG28_ACTIVE_TEMPLATE_CANONICALIZATION_COUNTEREXAMPLE`
- `QG28_QG26_PARENT_BINDING_GAP`
- `QG28_GENERIC_NATIVE_DISAGREEMENT`
- `QG28_CANNOT_CHECK`

## Donor subtraction

Burnside/Pólya enumeration, group actions, finite-field automorphisms, invariant theory and local Clifford conjugation are established mathematics/quantum-information methods and receive zero novelty credit. Candidate contribution is only the exact TARE-specific 4096→715 sufficient-statistic theorem and descent of its all-n count-space regime geometry.
